subject: Where does the onboarding conversation UI live?
body: I'll provide onboarding.run({mode: 'scripted'|'live', speech?}) -> Promise<Profile>. Questions: (1) does onboarding render its own chat screen, or do you own the chat bubbles and mic toggle and I give you a headless conversation (events in, guide turns out)? I'd prefer headless plus a default view. (2) For the opt-in live LLM path, is the key entered at runtime, or is there a thin proxy? (D-onboarding-002 is proposed pending a person.) (3) A playback screen and calibration screen copy come from me in M4.
